newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong's Hang Seng closes at record high.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong's Hang Seng closes at record high.

text.p: Hong Kong's Hang Seng index closed at a record high on Wednesday, up 143.81 points at 12,250.57, as large buy orders from Europe pushed prices higher in the last hour of trade, traders said.
The previous record close set by the blue chip index was 12,201.09 reached on January 4, 1994.
"European funds are getting in," said Ricky Tam, senior research analyst at Delta Asia Securities.

"Yesterday people tried to push the index down but it seems that it cannot break below 12,000 so people are changing their positions. In the futures market, a lot of big investors had short positions this morning and are changing to long positions," he said.
October Hang Seng futures jumped 130 points to 12,265.
Miles Remington, sales trader at Crosby Securities, said the market had been quiet until European markets opened.
The Hang Seng closed the morning down 25.02 at 12,081.74.
"We assume it must be from European buyers. The market was quiet until lunch time, then woke up in the second half when Europe becomes more active," he said.
Analysts noted a sharp rise in turnover during the afternoon session. Turnover totalled HK$6.21 billion at the end of the day compared to HK$2.99 billion during the morning session.
Tuesday's full-day turnover was HK$7.14 billion.
"Big buy orders have pushed up prices," said Frederick Tsang, head of research at PrimeEast Securities.
One broker said local investors had been squeezed by European buying.
"It's a short squeeze. London buyers stepped in the market, probably some local investors were being squeezed," he said.
The Hang Seng closed at its high for the day. The index hit an all-time intra-day high on January 4, 1994, of 12,599.23.

Property and banking stocks led the charge. Hang Seng Bank hit a record high of HK$87.25 during the session before closing up HK$2.75 at HK$87.00. HSBC Holdings hit an all-time intra-day high of HK$148.00 before closing at HK$147.50, up HK$1.50.
Henderson Land rose HK$1.50 to HK$69.75, Sun Hung Kai Properties rose HK$1.50 to HK$86.00 and Cheung Kong added HK$1.00 to HK$62.00. -- J.Genevieve (852) 2843 6345
